notes.title: 🤍❤️ FROM POLAND WITH LOVE 2025 🤍❤️
notes.content:
Poland is not just about pierogi, medieval castles, and Chopin. 
It’s also home to some of the world’s most talented game developers! 

This summer, we’ve teamed up with 28 Polish publishers and studios to celebrate the diverse gaming scene of our country!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/84b1517a973783f974d1c0b20c05d414b4e76b40.png


🤍 150+ games. Up to 90% off, all in one place, all made with love! ❤️
With iconic names like CD PROJEKT RED, 11 bit studios, Devolver Digital, Hooded Horse, Techland, Bloober Team, Creepy Jar, The Farm 51 and many more on board, this is your chance to experience Polish gaming like never before! 

Looking for heartfelt indies? Emotional journeys? Some cozy games? Or full-on AAA genre-defining blockbusters? We caught them all! 

Hits like Cyberpunk 2077, The Witcher 3, The Alters, or indie gems like Against The Storm, Everdream Valley, and Frozenheim are with us during this year's From Poland With Love!

This isn’t just a sale.
It’s a tribute from Untold Tales and other Polish devs to gamers around the world. 

 Stop here for a moment and perhaps rediscover old favorites or stumble into something completely new — this is your chance to experience the diverse fields of Polish game development.  


🤍❤️Start scrolling now & discover what Poland has to offer!🤍❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239077/58f239162cd6f8690dbaac9da5956a1d6ab3ef61.png
Spring is finally here, and with it the Steam Spring Sale arrives as well! 
As the world awakens from its winter slumber, there's no better time to immerse yourself in the vibrant worlds brought to you by Untold Tales.

Picture this: the sun streaming through your window, a gentle breeze whispering promises of adventure, and a vast array of games just waiting to be explored. Whether you're in the mood for heart-pounding action, immersive storytelling, or mind-bending puzzles, we've got you covered.

From gripping narratives to pulse-pounding gameplay, our portfolio has something for everyone: UNTOLD TALES SPRING SALE!
Join us on a journey through enchanted forests, dystopian cities, and far-off galaxies. With captivating stories, mesmerizing visuals, and unforgettable soundtracks, you'll find yourself lost in worlds beyond imagination.

So why wait? Jump into our world and explore the wonders that await. But remember, the sale ends on Thursday, March 21st, 2024, so grab your favorites before they're gone!

Warm regards, 
The Untold Tales Team

Spread the word and follow our way Twitter

notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Not Only Winter Is Coming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35923696/f1794376e5a371e223c9fd7c5ed7696e34c5add7.png
Greetings, adventurers!
Winter, with its frosty allure, has finally arrived! 
Embrace the enchantment of this festive season as the mischievous gaming sprite brings a touch of magic, unveiling upcoming new releases, must-haves, and Untold Tales classics for your home. 
Let the joyous gaming journey begin!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35923696/e3daa4802ad0b789e3c9b8b5ee77d2c5cfb718fa.png

For all you Martians out there - new playable DEMO of The Cub is here!
Tune in, explore the ruins of humanity, and relish your freedom in the world brought to you by creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Discover bits of the story and clues about how and why humanity fell, scattered throughout the world.
Spread the word, toss a wishlist and make sure to follow us for upcoming release news on this title! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35923696/9b6059c325cae0c4be98ba08e08e261126c131af.png

This festive season just keeps on giving, doesn't it? 
We celebrate Untold Tales with a special Publisher Steam Sale. Go ahead and treat yourself or wrap these titles as gifts for your friends <3
Psst, you can also grab our titles with special discounts on Nintendo Switch, because we are having Untold Tales Publisher Sale there as well


And if you're still wondering and afraid that you might miss a deal - worry no more. Brace yourselves - the Steam Winter Sale is coming your way! This year, you'll be able to hunt for deals from December 21 to January 4, 2024.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35923696/4cddb956b5c6ebbbb0f182b9a82f4f53a3994d3b.png
This goes out to all the renovating pros, Mr. & Mrs. Handyman: if you are ready to test out your cooperation skills be sure to follow Tools Up! which will be dropping the Ultimate Edition soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551920/Tools_Up_Ultimate_Edition/


We are thrilled to announce our collaboration with VARSAV Games Studios to bring you Giants Uprising! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109160/Giants_Uprising/


Feeling a bit cold? Then jump into Flame Keeper and get ready for the newest Biome filled with arcade elements, new enemies and hazard zones!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper/


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35923696/c1faa962c68076dbb53b5c38f2f12e09768c8d20.png
Thank you for embarking on this brief adventure with us, and we look forward to having you accompany us on future journeys. As we anticipate and prepare for upcoming exciting news, stay connected with us on our social media platforms:

Facebook / Twitter  / Instagram / TikTok / YouTube

Previously on Untold Tales Presents

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

Aaaaand if you are a fan of games, bundles and pretty hefty deals be sure to check our UntoldBundles.com where you can find the craziest daily deals on the market.

The Steam Awards 2023 are coming! Right now, you can nominate your favorite game in various categories, and this year we've selected a few of our titles to compete for your votes:

Flame Keeper for the “Best Game You Suck At” category;
Atone: Heart of the Elder Tree for the “Best Soundtrack” category;
Bang-On Balls: Chronicles for the “Better With Friends” category;
Boti: Byteland Overclocked for the “Outstanding Visual Style” category;
Everdream Valley for the “Sit Back And Relax” category.

Your one click can make a difference and means a lot to us and the devs.
So hesitate no more — vote now for your favorite title!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/65cd2bb2da48748842ada3177342b3a160d91551.png

Thanks for joining us on this short adventure and we hope to see you again on the road. And while waiting for new, exciting news - be sure to follow us on our socials

notes.title: Flame Keeper is out now!
notes.content:
Flame Keeper is 33% at launch for the first week + free arcade shooter included!

Our fiery action roguelite with a twist, Flame Keeper, is out now, and... what's that in Ignis' mailbox? A coupon for "idyllic holidays on UTOPIA 9, the best vacation resort the galaxy has to offer"? 
That sounds like fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230

Buy Flame Keeper and get a free copy of UTOPIA 9 - A Volatile Vacation, the sci-fi twin-stick shooter roguelike where your space cruise is dropping you on a mutant-infested planet! Fight your way to escape this hellish destination and sue the travel agency! Featuring evolving enemies, procedurally generated levels and local coop up to 4 players! Grab it now for free when you purchase Flame Keeper, as this will be available until 30 April, 2023.

We've Got Bundles Galour

If you thought that this piñata couldn't give any more candies, Flame Keeper is getting two bundles!

First up is Flame Keeper + Arise: A Simple Story, where you time travel through your memories in a poetical journey about love and loss.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31331

Then there's Flame Keeper + Bang-on Balls: Chronicles, where you have fun banging historically inaccurate goofy balls with your friends (yes).

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31332

Finally, we've got the full Untold Tales Collection with 12 suave indie games for all you connoisseurs *chef's kiss* 🧑‍🍳
 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31310/Untold_Tales_Bundle/

---

May the Eternal Flame prevail,

Ignis, the Kautki Cave crew and the Untold Tales team

notes.title: Patch 1.04a Hotfix
notes.content:
A quick hotfix for a bug in the latest patch. 

Fixes:

 Fixed bug that depleted slowmotion power faster on medium setting than before the patch, also fixed depletion on easy mode, being 50% slower now.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 Released
notes.content:
Hello!

We just released patch 1.04. This will add two new difficulty settings(easy, hard) to the existing(medium) one. 

Patch Notes

Added:

 Hard and Easy difficulty settings.
 Different leaderboards for different difficulty settings
 Option to see the user rank in leaderboards
 Total kills display at level end screen


Bug Fixes: 

 Controller setup in pause menu bug


Changes:

 Updated achievements so that "Hard Boiled", "Just another day", "A master at my skill", "End of the week" and "Done and done!" can only be unlocked on medium difficulty

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Released
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we are releasing patch 1.03. This will add the option to rebind your keys and fixing some minor bugs.

Patch Notes

Added:
		Added the option to rebind keys
Added the option to use hardware mouse input

Bug Fixes: 
Fixed bug when holding down dive button would not make the player dive
Fixed player death sound not being affected by volume settings
Fixed "Master at my skill" achievement not being unlocked

Changes:
Added the option to unlock "Hard-Boiled" and "Just another day" without starting a new game

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
Today we are pushing out a small patch to mainly adress the aim speed when using the mouse.

Patch Notes

Added:
		Added the option to restart a level when died by pressing the reload button
Added the option to change the crosshair color

Bug Fixes: 
Fixed bug that did not save some settings when exiting the game
Fixed bug that made you unable to change/save quality settings
Fixed bug that made the game not start when in offline mode
Fixed bug that showed wrong and low-res controls for game-pad

Changes:
Removed mouse slowdown in slow-motion, can be activated back with Legacy Aim in menu.
Balanced the default mouse speed, and making it possible to have a even lower speed.
